summary: Dogfood the current Project Review System against the local-first refactor roadmap and preserve the End-to-end-discovered governance gap without retroactive stage credit.
reason: End-to-end validation discovered that the initial roadmap review used the five semantic stages without the current Project Review System's governed Adaptive Execution/change-impact/pass-boundary machinery. Prior semantic reports are preserved as uncredited analysis. Review revision 1 reopens at Adversarial against the current roadmap snapshot, with a durable gate created before new pass credit. The dogfooding-gap note is an implementation-planning requirement, not retroactive evidence. Revision-1 Adversarial then re-attacked the full corrected roadmap under the current gate and found no blocking defect; nonblocking collaboration-provenance, dirty-snapshot, and executable-adapter assurance obligations were handed to Interdependency and later implementation validation. Revision-1 Interdependency then mapped those obligations into single-owner producer/consumer contracts: governed-dogfood preflight is a workflow-state projection, imported bundles preserve rather than upgrade provenance/assurance, snapshot capture owns dirty-working-tree semantics, provider configuration owns permissions while containment claims require separate evidence, visible pass commit SHA is observability rather than authority, and current-system authority persists through explicit migration cutover. Revision-1 Structural Optimization retained the selected minimal architecture and placed the new dogfooding requirements inside existing engine/adapter/bundle boundaries rather than creating new authorities or permanent artifact families.
future_requirements: User-visible durable-pass identity: every governed semantic-pass response should surface the Git commit SHA that first records that pass's completion/credit. This gives the operator an immediately checkable durable-state boundary and makes accidental or attempted multi-pass backfilling visibly harder to hide. The SHA supplements, rather than replaces, execution_unit_id, boundary identity, handoff chaining, and deterministic chronology checks.

findings: The dogfooding false-credit defect is now explicitly contained: earlier ungated stage reports remain historical analysis only, and governed credit restarts at revision 1 with a pre-existing Adversarial gate.

The selected local-first architecture still preserves the major Adversarial invariants: semantic/mechanical separation, exact snapshot binding, least-privilege provider configuration, no required hosted CI, replay/concurrency controls, migration integrity, manual fallback, and breadth enforcement.

Portable review-bundle import must preserve reviewer/authority provenance as well as lineage; Interdependency should assign the producer/consumer contract so imported evidence cannot silently gain stronger authority than its source.

The Git snapshot adapter must make dirty-working-tree/snapshot-capture behavior explicit, and executable external adapters must not be described as proven network-isolated merely because they are configured as local; these are implementation assurance obligations already bounded by the exact-snapshot and provider-trust requirements.
unresolved_conditions: Interdependency must map ownership and authority for governed-dogfood mode/preflight, imported portable-bundle provenance, and any assurance label applied to executable external adapters.
Later implementation and End-to-end validation must test dirty Git working-tree snapshot behavior rather than assuming commit identity and reviewed bytes are always the same.

findings: Governed-dogfood mode has one authority path: the user declares the mode, then the current workflow/state authority resolves the applicable Project Review System controls before semantic credit; the preflight is a generated projection and cannot itself override workflow state.

Portable review bundles must carry source lineage plus reviewer identity, independence/assurance labels, semantic-result provenance, and relevant provider provenance. Import validation may reject or preserve those claims but may not upgrade them merely because the bundle is accepted locally.

The snapshot adapter owns capture of the reviewed bytes, including explicit dirty-working-tree policy. Inventory, retrieval indexes, semantic packets, gates, and completion evidence consume one resulting snapshot ID rather than independently interpreting Git HEAD or working-tree state.

Provider configuration remains user-owned; an adapter may declare that it runs locally, but network isolation or other stronger containment is a separate assurance claim requiring an enforcing mechanism or explicit unknown status.

The user-visible pass commit SHA is a generated observability field derived from durable history: it should identify the first commit that records the pass occurrence, supplementing rather than replacing execution-unit identity, boundary identity, and handoff chronology.
Legacy/current-system authority remains in force through migration until an explicitly validated cutover; the new engine cannot certify its own bootstrap or silently reinterpret old evidence.
unresolved_conditions: Normalization must standardize the vocabulary for governed dogfooding versus semantic-method-only use, imported provenance/assurance labels, dirty versus captured snapshots, and the user-visible durable pass commit.
Implementation and End-to-end validation must prove the selected Git snapshot capture behavior and portable-bundle import semantics rather than relying on these design contracts alone.

findings: Use `governed dogfooding` for running the current Project Review System with all applicable workflow controls and claiming governed stage credit. Use `semantic-method-only review` for applying one or more semantic lenses without claiming that governed Project Review System execution occurred.

Use `captured snapshot` for the exact bytes frozen by the snapshot adapter and `snapshot ID` for their canonical identity. `Dirty working tree` describes a pre-capture Git condition; avoid `dirty snapshot`, because a credited snapshot must itself be exact and immutable for its identity.

Portable review bundles preserve `provenance` as source metadata and retain canonical `reviewer independence` labels (`Independent`, `Same-agent self-review`, `Mixed`) separately from provider identity or other assurance evidence. Import acceptance does not change those labels.

Use `local execution` only to mean the adapter/provider process runs on the local machine. Use `network isolation` only when an enforcing mechanism or evidence supports that stronger containment claim; otherwise treat network access as unknown/configuration-dependent.

Use `durable pass commit SHA` for the first Git commit that durably records a credited pass occurrence. It is a generated observability reference, not the execution-unit ID, boundary ID, gate identity, semantic result, or authority.
Use `governed-dogfood preflight` for the generated view of currently applicable controls before first semantic credit. It is not a new status, gate authority, or sixth stage.

Use `legacy evidence` for pre-cutover Project Review System records, and `cutover` for the explicit validated transition at which the replacement workflow becomes current authority. Do not normalize historical evidence in place to newer vocabulary.
unresolved_conditions: Structural Optimization must determine where these normalized terms live with the least permanent documentation burden and whether the durable pass commit SHA should be rendered by the core status/completion output or a Git-specific adapter view.

Implementation and End-to-end validation must test captured-snapshot behavior for dirty Git working trees, bundle provenance preservation, and the distinction between local execution and network isolation.

findings: Keep the previously selected minimal architecture: one local workflow engine, SQLite as the reference transactional persistence backend, generated status/plan views, thin provider adapters, a default Git snapshot adapter, portable lineage-aware review bundles, and optional host verification. The governed dogfood recovery does not justify adding another permanent orchestration layer.

Implement governed-dogfood preflight as a generated `preflight/status` view from the same workflow engine and current control mapping. Do not create a separate dogfood tracker, authority, or sixth stage.

Place normalized dogfooding/snapshot/provenance terminology in existing canonical workflow/schema documentation when implementation occurs; do not create a standalone permanent glossary solely for this refactor.

Keep imported provenance, reviewer-independence labels, and provider provenance inside the portable review-bundle/evidence schema. Do not create a parallel provenance database or sidecar unless a later consumer requires different retention or access controls.

Keep snapshot capture inside the repository/snapshot adapter boundary. For Git, the adapter must either deterministically capture the exact governed working-tree bytes (including declared uncommitted state) or reject the capture; it must never silently substitute Git HEAD for the reviewed bytes. No second snapshot authority is needed.

Render the `durable pass commit SHA` only in Git-backed user-facing status/completion output. The core occurrence model remains provider/VCS-neutral and owns logical occurrence identity; Git history supplies the SHA as an environment-specific observability locator.

Do not turn `local execution` versus `network isolation` into a new framework. Provider configuration records allowed egress/capabilities, while stronger isolation is an optional separately evidenced enforcement property.

Retain evaluation integration, breadth accounting, migration cutover, manual fallback, and deferred dynamic subdivision as already selected. None is made simpler or safer by adding a new permanent artifact discovered during dogfooding.

Full structural breadth check found no material duplicate authority, unnecessary permanent artifact, accidental vendor coupling, or inferior structure introduced by the recovery requirements; the remaining implementation choices are bounded adapter/schema details for End-to-end validation rather than reasons to reopen an earlier stage.
unresolved_conditions: End-to-end validation must exercise a dirty/uncommitted Git snapshot path and verify that reviewed bytes cannot be silently replaced by Git HEAD.

End-to-end validation must exercise portable-bundle import without provenance or independence upgrading, local-provider failure/manual fallback, and Git-backed rendering of the first durable pass commit SHA.
Implementation planning must preserve the current-system-to-new-engine cutover path without requiring the unfinished new engine to certify itself.
